context: The smart advisor is a chat panel on every page of the site. Its persona is «بلبل» (Bulbul), the site mascot, a white-cheeked bulbul bird. The persona speaks warmly and playfully; the Arabic greeting is written in the Gulf / Al-Ahsa dialect by the owner. The panel opens from a floating round button (bird icon + short text) in the bottom corner. The answers themselves are generated by the model in the page language; these 17 strings are only the interface around them. Until now the panel on /zh/ /de/ /ru/ /ur/ showed no text at all (icon + Latin brand), because English fallback strings are not allowed on those pages. When ui.<lang>['advisor.title'] exists, ALL 17 keys render, so all 17 must be translated together. Arabic is the authority; English is the working source. Plain text only (no markdown). Line breaks in advisor.intro are real \n and must be kept (three lines). The brand name stays in Latin script as «Visit Al-Ahsa» (the four lines render the brand in Latin; for /ur/ the BRAND item is open with the owner, provisional ruling: no brand is coined or transliterated). «Anthropic» stays in Latin script. Latin digits only.

keys.role: Visible text on the floating button next to the bird icon, and its aria-label. An invitation to ask the mascot. Must be short: it sits in a pill button on phones (aim ≤ 14 Latin characters / ≤ 6 CJK characters / ≤ 3 Urdu words).
Heading (h2) at the top of the open chat panel, next to the bird's head. Names the mascot and what it is. Brand stays Latin «Visit Al-Ahsa».

The mascot's first chat bubble when the panel opens (three lines, split on \n, each rendered as its own paragraph). Persona voice, warm and informal in tone, but keep the line's binding address form. Arabic meaning: line 1 «يا هلا والله!» = a hearty Gulf welcome + the two emoji, kept as they are; line 2 = I am Bulbul, I know Al-Ahsa palm by palm (every palm tree, i.e. intimately); line 3 = are you here for a stroll, or do you want places only the locals («أهل الديرة», people of the home town) know? Tell me what you like and I will set up an outing («طلعة») to your mood/taste. No facts beyond these.
keys.ar:
يا هلا والله! 🐦🌴
أنا بلبل، أعرف الأحساء نخلة نخلة!
جاي تتمشى، ولا تبي أماكن ما يعرفها إلا أهل الديرة؟ علّمني وش تحب، وأنا أضبط لك طلعة على مزاجك.
keys.en:
Hala! 🐦🌴
I’m Bulbul, and I know Al-Ahsa palm by palm.
Just strolling, or after the places only locals know? Tell me what you like and I’ll shape an outing to your mood.

keys.role: Placeholder of the message input (textarea), also its aria-label.
aria-label of the send button (an icon button; read by screen readers only).
aria-label of the close (×) button of the panel (screen readers only).

Small note under the input. A factual privacy/scope notice: answers come only from the site's content; questions are processed through Anthropic's service and are not stored. Nothing added, nothing dropped (the legal page is the owner's; do not strengthen or soften).
keys.ar: يجيب من محتوى الموقع فقط. تُعالَج الأسئلة عبر خدمة Anthropic ولا تُحفظ.
keys.en: Answers come from this site’s content only. Questions are processed by Anthropic’s service and are not stored.

keys.role: Shown in the chat when the service is switched off or the monthly budget is used up. Points the visitor to the attraction pages or to the trip-planning page. The page name MUST be the exact published nav label of that page in the target language: ui.<lang>['nav.plan'] (zh «行程规划», de «Reise planen», ru «План поездки», ur «سفر کا منصوبہ بنائیں»), in that language's quotation marks. «المعالم» = the attractions (use the line's established term).
keys.ar: بلبل يستريح الآن. تصفّح المعالم أو صفحة «خطّط لرحلتك».
keys.en: Bulbul is resting right now. Browse the attractions or the “Plan your trip” page.

keys.role: Shown when the visitor has reached the daily limit of questions. Friendly; says see you tomorrow and that the attraction pages are available meanwhile.
keys.ar: بلغت الحد اليومي للأسئلة. نلتقي غداً، وصفحات المعالم بين يديك.
keys.en: You have reached today’s question limit. See you tomorrow; the attraction pages are all yours.

keys.role: Shown when the request fails (network/server). Asks to try again shortly.
keys.ar: تعذّر الوصول إلى بلبل. حاول مرة أخرى بعد قليل.
keys.en: Bulbul could not be reached. Please try again shortly.

keys.role: Small heading above a list of linked page cards (attractions, restaurants, articles…) that the mascot returns under an answer.

Suggested-question button shown before the first message. On click its text is SENT AS THE VISITOR'S OWN QUESTION to the model, so it must read as a natural question a visitor types, first person. Short (a wrapping pill button).
keys.en: What should I see in one day?

keys.role: Suggested-question button (sent as the visitor's question). Asks the opening hours and fees of Jabal Al-Qarah: use the line's termbase name for Jabal Al-Qarah exactly as published.

Suggested-question button (sent as the visitor's question). Where can I try Al-Ahsa cuisine? The Arabic says «المطبخ الأحسائي» (the cuisine of Al-Ahsa); the English «Hasawi food» deviates — follow the Arabic and the line's termbase term for Al-Ahsa cuisine / the Al-Ahsa adjective (site rule: «الأحسائي» not «الحساوي»).
keys.en: Where can I try Hasawi food?

keys.role: aria-label of the animated 'typing' bubble while the answer is being generated (screen readers only).
Label for the visitor's own messages (reserved; not rendered by the current component). One word: «you».
aria-label of the 'new conversation' button in the panel header (clears the chat).
